title: The Scientist Who Froze Himself to Death—and Came Back
hook: A cryogenics pioneer had his body frozen after death, but DNA analysis revealed something terrifying.
why_this_can_go_viral: Combines death, resurrection, and a hidden truth—triggers morbid curiosity and debate about life extension.

title: The Lab Fire That Released a Cloud of Poison—and Killed a Town
hook: A chemical plant explosion in India leaked a gas that turned lungs into liquid—thousands died in hours.
why_this_can_go_viral: One of history's deadliest industrial accidents—visceral, shocking, and largely unknown to younger audiences.

title: The Biolab That Grew Human Ears on Mice—and They Started Hearing
hook: Scientists grew a human ear on a mouse's back—but the real horror began when it responded to sound.
why_this_can_go_viral: Visually shocking and ethically disturbing—perfect for triggering disgust and fascination loops on short-form platforms.

title: The Scientific Fraud Who Invented a 'Cancer Vaccine'—and Killed 50 Patients
hook: A doctor claimed he cured cancer with a secret serum—autopsies showed tumors growing inside tumors.
why_this_can_go_viral: High emotion—betrayal of hope, death toll, and a villainous scientist create a narrative that demands sharing.

title: The Neuroscientist Who Made People Hallucinate—With a Magnet
hook: A simple magnetic coil above the skull made subjects see ghosts, hear voices, and feel invisible hands.
why_this_can_go_viral: Mind control via magnet—short, visual, and deeply unsettling. Viewers will question reality.

title: The Lab Catastrophe Where a Scientist Inhaled Anthrax—and Lived to Tell
hook: A biodefense researcher accidentally breathed in a lethal dose of anthrax—but didn't get sick.
why_this_can_go_viral: Survival against impossible odds—creates suspense and questions about hidden immune systems.

title: The Chemistry Disaster That Turned a River Into Acid—and Dissolved a Bridge
hook: A chemical spill in a small town turned a river into sulfuric acid—steel bridges began to bubble.
why_this_can_go_viral: Visually dramatic—melting infrastructure in real footage. Environmental horror combined with human negligence.

title: The Biologist Who Discovered That Trees Scream—and Recorded It
hook: When a tree is cut, it emits ultrasonic screams that scientists recorded—and other plants react in fear.
why_this_can_go_viral: Anthropomorphic shock—people love personifying nature. Subverts assumption that plants are passive.

title: The Scientific Fraud Who Published a Paper Made by a Random Word Generator
hook: A fake researcher submitted a nonsensical AI-generated paper to a top journal—and it got published.
why_this_can_go_viral: Humiliates the academic establishment—people love watching systems fail. Relatable anger at institutional stupidity.

title: The Physicist Who Caused a Nuclear Meltdown—With a Flashlight
hook: A maintenance worker shone a flashlight into a reactor core—and triggered a chain reaction that melted down.
why_this_can_go_viral: Absurd but true—a flashlight causing nuclear disaster. Ironic, terrifying, and highly shareable.

title: The Biolab That Created a Plastic-Eating Bacteria—and It Ate the Lab
hook: Scientists engineered a microbe that digests plastic—then it mutated and began eating rubber, steel, and concrete.
why_this_can_go_viral: Sci-fi disaster scenario—'grey goo' fears made real. High visual potential and environmental dread.

title: The Scientific Fraud Who Faked a 'Spontaneous Human Combustion' Study
hook: A researcher claimed humans can burst into flames from internal causes—his 'proof' was a hoax that fooled coroners.
why_this_can_go_viral: Morbid mystery—people love the idea of unexplained combustion. Exposure of fraud adds satisfying debunk angle.

title: The Lab Catastrophe Where a Scientist Was Swallowed by a Giant Magnet
hook: A physicist working on an MRI got pulled into the machine—the magnetic field crushed his internal organs against the bore.
why_this_can_go_viral: Visceral, horrific body horror—the idea of being slowly crushed by invisible forces is deeply unsettling and shareable.

title: The Chemist Who Discovered a Poison That Erases Memory—and Tested It on Himself
hook: A chemist synthesized a compound that made him forget the past 10 years—he woke up a stranger in his own life.
why_this_can_go_viral: Identity horror—losing yourself to a chemical. Plays on fear of memory loss and personal annihilation.

title: The Physicist Who Proved That the Future Can Change the Past—With a Laser
hook: A delayed-choice quantum experiment showed that a laser's path was decided after it had already passed.
why_this_can_go_viral: Mind-bending time paradox—easily visualized with laser demonstrations. Sparks deep philosophical discussion in comments.

title: The Neuroscientist Who Implanted False Memories—and Made Subjects Commit Crimes
hook: Researchers convinced volunteers they had committed a crime as teenagers—and the subjects confessed to it.
why_this_can_go_viral: Disturbing and unjust—shows how fragile memory is. Triggers fear of false accusations and legal outrage.

title: The Quantum Computer That Talked to Another Universe—and Shut Down
hook: A quantum computer briefly connected to what scientists believe was a parallel universe—then it overheated and crashed.
why_this_can_go_viral: Extreme sci-fi premise that sounds like fiction but has real research behind it. Drives massive curiosity and debate.

title: The Forbidden Experiment Where a Scientist Kept Babies in Isolation—to Create a New Language
hook: A medieval ruler raised infants in silence to see if they would spontaneously speak Hebrew—they never spoke.
why_this_can_go_viral: Dark historical experiment—children as test subjects. Morbid curiosity and outrage drive engagement.

title: The Biolab That Created a Virus That Makes Humans Love Parasites—and It Leaked
hook: A lab engineered a virus that made mice seek out parasitic worms—then a technician got infected and started craving dirt.
why_this_can_go_viral: Body horror meets mind control—irresistible fear of losing one's will. Drives strong reaction and sharing.
